title: Tech Support: How to run Intel Driver Update Utility
description: Micro Center Tech Support shows you how to run Intel Driver Update Utility. http://www.microcentertech.com

asr.full_text: Are you looking for a quick and easy way to make sure your motherboard has the updated drivers for all its devices? Well, if you have an Intel motherboard you are in luck! This is Paul from Micro Center and for today I'm going to show you how to use the Intel Driver Update Utility. Let's get started! All right, to get started, you want to open up the internet and go to www.intel.com. It will automatically default you to this other address, go to www.intel.com it'll automatically default you to this this other address, content.www.us.en home page html, but intel.com will bring you right here. We want to click on menu support under downloads and drivers click on Get the Latest Drivers. Up at the top we want to click on Run Intel driver update utility. Alright. About the middle of the page you'll see a button that says Check your system for Latest Updates. Go ahead and click on that. It's going to load this tool. It's going to ask you if you want to load it. Click install. Click on Check your system for latest updates okay so what it's down is it's now looked at the the motherboard edits searching for updates for the components on it let's look at the uh... chipset software inflation till it looks like there is a new version of that There's no update on this one! I think everything else looks fine it's in good shape on this computer. Not a bad idea to run this every now and then. It saves you the trouble of trying to chase these down individually. So I'll go ahead and click on Download now. Once that pops up click on Run. This is going to look like any other update to the computer. So in this case, click on Next, Yes. Of course you might get something completely different this will take a few minutes to install okay so once it's complete go ahead and click on finish it's going to ask you to reboot we're actually going to let that reboot later thats how you use the Intel driver update utility. If you have any other questions, come visit us at www.microcentretek.com.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is an instructional demonstration of Intel's driver-update process, including scanning hardware and installing an available update. The Intel utility interface and Micro Center references are presented in a technical-support context rather than as a financial or credential solicitation. The material does not independently establish the safety or behavior of any external website.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational technology tutorial explaining how to run Intel's driver utility, scan hardware for updates and install an available driver update.
